$comment: Runtime knobs for the Stacks factory. See DESIGN.md.
$max_parallel: Implementers in flight. Ceiling is 3 on this machine; Xcode, not the harness, is the constraint.
$max_attempts: Implementer attempts before the Opus rescue attempt. After the rescue, the task is parked.
$dispatchable_types: decide and spike are never dispatched. They queue to the human.
$simulator: Single named destination for all sim work, held under state/locks/sim.lock.

invariant_baselines.$system_size_call_sites: Deliberately null. This number moves with active development (29 at HEAD f93d48f, 57 in the working tree on 2026-08-24). invariants.sh must measure it against the merge-base with main at run time and assert non-increase, never against a number frozen in this file.
invariant_baselines.$allowed_imports: Apple frameworks only. Anything outside this list fails the gate: the Data Not Collected privacy label depends on there being no third-party SDK, ever.

$banned_identifiers: The guilt-engine ban from ROADMAP.md. A library does not nag.
$land_requires_human: true: the overseer must get your sign-off before instructing an agent to land. false: it lands on its own judgement once the gate is green and /code-review low is clean. Start true; flip it when the loop has earned it.
$review: Code review is /code-review low, run by the overseer against the task branch. The overseer separately checks acceptance criteria and the constitution — /code-review does not do that.
